mapper.select: SELECT t1.id, t1.NAME, t1.icon AS cuIcon, t1.color, IFNULL(count(DISTINCT t2.id),0) AS badge FROM tag t1 LEFT JOIN photoinfo t2 ON t1.id = t2.tag_id GROUP BY t1.id, t1.NAME, t1.icon;

select t1.id,t1.photo_url as photoUrl,t1.tag_id as tagId,t1.dateTime,t1.user_id as userId,t1.file_path as filePath , t1.fingerprint,t1.title from photoinfo t1 left join tag t2 on t1.tag_id=t2.id where t2.id=#{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}
